tools.name: render
tools.does: page.html to PNG with the local Edge or Chrome (headless, local files only); args: page, out PNG path, optional WxH size

args.name: page
args.does: path to the page.html to render

args.name: out
args.does: path of the PNG to write

args.name: size
args.does: WxH in pixels, default 1280x720

for: factory F6: listing cover PNGs
marketing-studio: ad squares and heroes
jobhunt: CV page to PNG

tools.name: thumb
tools.does: 256px thumbnail PNG of a design from its brief.json (the size a store listing shows), written beside the brief

args.name: brief
args.does: path to the design's brief.json

args.name: out
args.does: thumbnail PNG path, default beside the brief

for: factory F6: cover readable at listing size
marketing-studio: ad thumbnails

tools.name: audit
tools.does: audits a design from its brief.json: contrast, size, title box, 256px legibility, RTL; PASS or FAIL per check, writes design-audit.json

args.name: brief
args.does: path to the design's brief.json

for: factory F6: gate before a cover is adopted
marketing-studio: ad gate
jobhunt: Hebrew RTL CV gate

tools.name: judge
tools.does: scores a design from its brief.json with rubric ds-quality-v1 (10 checks, ship at 8); writes DESIGN-REVIEW.md, prints SHIP or REWORK

args.name: brief
args.does: path to the design's brief.json (or its folder)

for: factory F6: ship or rework verdict for a cover
marketing-studio: ad verdict

tools.name: tokens
tools.does: builds tokens.css (light and dark, no hardcoded colors) and a docs page from a brand tokens.json, written beside the json

args.name: tokens_json
args.does: path to the brand's tokens.json

for: factory: one brand palette for every cover
marketing-studio: campaign brand tokens

tools.name: block
tools.does: emits one landing block (hero works with defaults) as an HTML section on stdout; all colors through var(--*)

args.name: block
args.does: block id from templates/registry.json, for example hero

args.name: slot1
args.does: a SLOT=value pair, for example TITLE=Hello

args.name: slot2
args.does: a second SLOT=value pair

args.name: slot3
args.does: a third SLOT=value pair

for: factory F6: free magnet and listing pages
marketing-studio: landing hero

tools.name: assets
tools.does: lists a product preview/ folder's pictures (size, bytes, sha256, used or not, largest first) and copies them into designs/<order>/assets/ + assets.json; fetches CC0 stock (polyhaven, ambientcg, openverse license=cc0) into packs/donors/<source>-<slug>/ with SOURCE.json

args.name: product
args.does: order id whose preview/ pictures to list, e.g. product O-001

args.name: copy
args.does: comma file names to copy, e.g. --copy a.png,b.png

args.name: stock
args.does: CC0 stock fetch, e.g. stock polyhaven "paper" --kind texture

for: factory F6: real product pictures and CC0 backdrops with receipts
every cover: assets.json with sha256 + size
tools.first_job: listed O-001 (19) and O-004 (35) preview pictures, copied 2 each, fetched polyhaven paper texture for O-005

tools.name: free-image
tools.does: lists the live free image models (every price field 0, today the 2 ming-image design models) and, only with a key plus explicit --prompt/--out, renders one 1280x720 background (aborts unless usage.cost is 0); paid models stay refused at budget 0

args.name: free
args.does: live free-model list, then wait or render

args.name: prompt
args.does: background prompt for the one render (with --out)

args.name: out
args.does: PNG path for the one render plus .receipt.json

for: covers and post visuals: generated backgrounds only, never product pictures
tools.first_job: live list shows the 2 free models; no call without explicit --prompt plus --out

tools.name: orders

args.name: covers

tools.name: fonts
tools.does: copies used OFL-1.1 woff2 files from node_modules/@fontsource into fonts/<family>/ + fonts.css (relative @font-face, font-display swap) + per-family OFL.txt; pairs and proof

args.name: add
args.does: families to embed, e.g. add heebo frank-ruhl-libre --subsets hebrew,latin --weights 400,700

args.name: pair
args.does: pair he (Hebrew body+headings) or pair display (two bold Latin families, OFL-1.1 verified)

for: every design: same pixels in the customer repo, real Hebrew text in CV PDFs

factory O-002: Inter + Rubik latin display
